name: maxgfr-skills
description: maxgfr's process skills for agent-driven engineering — installable as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: maxgfr
plugins.description: One loop, three skills the agent runs when they fit: blueprint plans a change and gets it approved, build implements the approved plan step by step in a worktree, and verify proves the result. A large model plans and audits, a small one codes, a medium one reviews; tiers map to models in one config file. Skills land under the maxgfr: namespace.
